title: Variance Decomposition & ANOVA
description: A focused, compact advanced path on partitioning variance between groups: the F-statistic, sum-of-squares decomposition, linear-combination variance, and what ANOVA answers that a t-test cannot.
outcomes: You'll partition total variance into between- and within-group components, interpret the F-statistic, compute variance for linear combinations, and know when ANOVA is the right tool over pairwise t-tests.
